threshold_policies.tF1_reference: D1 validation maximum macro F1; ties highest threshold
threshold_policies.t5_reference: D1 validation maximum attack recall subject to empirical FPR <= 0.05; ties highest threshold
threshold_policies.R95_exploratory: highest D1 validation threshold with empirical attack recall >= 0.95

diagnostics.case_selection: first baseline false positive by source_row in each benign D3 technique

boundaries: The study is motivated by already observed D3/D4 results and is not a new untouched confirmatory test.
All model fitting uses D1 train only; checkpoint and threshold choices use D1 validation only.
No D2/D3/D4 label, text or template enters training or parameter selection.
No additional class-weight, recall-floor or learning-rate search is allowed after external evaluation.
The original E4 model and handoff remain unchanged; these outputs do not replace E6 official thresholds.
All external outcomes, including deterioration, will be reported. A fresh held-out source is needed for confirmation.
